about_the_game:
About The Demo

In the demo, you will explore one level, the Great Paw Islands, and secure several outposts with an ever-growing clan of puppies. You will also be given several optional side-quests for various NPC puppies, like getting rid of the nasty scum infecting the upper highlands, or fetching tools for the blacksmith.

About The Full Game

Pick your breed, and build your clan. An open-world adventure about a pup from the Scottish highlands destined to the lead a rebellion against the evil Cat King Of England.

Explore the beautiful open world of the Paw Isles, rescuing and gaining control of a variety of different dog breeds, from the Schnauzers in Shnuazerland, to the Pugs in Pugton.

Upgrade your weapons and armor.

Bark to convince rogue dogs to join your rebellion.

Name and upgrade your clan of pups.

Gain new abilities to traverse a gorgeous open world reminiscent of Wind Waker and Breath of the Wild.

Listen to beautiful Scottish music as you lead your pack of pups.
